column.name: entity_id
column.comment: Entity ID

column.name: order_id
column.comment: Magento order entity ID

column.name: increment_id
column.comment: Magento order increment ID (sent to Quickshipper as integrationOrderId)

column.name: store_id
column.comment: Store scope (resolves the Quickshipper login)

column.name: shipment_id
column.comment: Magento shipment entity ID, once the shipment is saved

column.name: provider_id
column.comment: Quickshipper courier (provider) ID

column.name: price_key
column.comment: Chosen Quickshipper price ID as in the shipping method code (lower-case, alphanumeric)

column.name: provider_name
column.comment: Courier name as Quickshipper reported it at booking

column.name: dropoff_latitude
column.comment: Drop-off latitude the customer was quoted for

column.name: dropoff_longitude
column.comment: Drop-off longitude the customer was quoted for

column.name: scheduled_time
column.comment: Delivery time the customer chose, slot start in UTC (ISO 8601); null = as soon as possible

column.name: paid_amount
column.comment: Shipping the customer paid for this delivery, in tetri (0 for an extra delivery)

column.name: charged_amount
column.comment: Courier price Quickshipper charged at booking, in tetri

column.name: service_fee
column.comment: Quickshipper platform fee at booking, in tetri

column.name: qshpr_order_id
column.comment: Quickshipper order ID

column.name: qshpr_order_no
column.comment: Quickshipper order number shown to people (e.g. SQ42609), the shipment tracking number

column.name: tracking_url
column.comment: Quickshipper tracking page

column.name: state
column.comment: Delivery state: quoted, drafted, dispatched, abandoned, delivered, cancelled or failed

column.name: qshpr_status
column.comment: Quickshipper order status last read (e.g. OnTheWay)

column.name: courier_name
column.comment: Courier Quickshipper assigned, as reported

column.name: status_changed_at
column.comment: When qshpr_status last changed

column.name: status_checked_at
column.comment: When Quickshipper was last asked for the status

column.name: alerted_at
column.comment: When the merchant was told this booking without a shipment needs them (told once)

column.name: dispatch_due_at
column.comment: When automatic booking is due (order paid); null when not due

column.name: dispatch_attempts
column.comment: Automatic booking attempts that failed

column.name: last_error
column.comment: Why the last automatic booking attempt failed

column.name: created_at
column.comment: Created at

column.name: updated_at
column.comment: Last update

column.name: shubo_qshpr_delivery_time
column.comment: Quickshipper delivery time chosen at checkout, slot start in UTC (ISO 8601)
